claim_scope: Unit-norm logarithmic dilates of h_c-h_1 in L2 of the positive half-line; exact Gram and sharp dense-scale Riesz bounds.
integrity: Analytical proof supplied with exact Gram identities and a uniform near-antipodal minimum argument. Packaged computations are supporting checks, not proofs of infinite statements. No independence or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The sequence is not complete in the ambient L2 space. Bounds concern its coefficient Gramian, not translated filterbank analysis. The exact minimizing frequency at arbitrary fixed c is not classified; only its asymptotic value is needed. Historical implicit equivalent results remain possible.
title: Sharp dense-scale conditioning of causal exponential-difference dilates
